New Support System

Greetings everyone!

As part of our commitment to improve every aspect of ArcheAge Classic with the upcoming major updates, you'll be able to find an upgraded Support system on the website!

To submit a ticket, users are now encouraged to go on their website Profile, under the SUPPORT tab.

The existing Discord tickets will not be disabled yet but we are strongly encouraging users to migrate over there for any new tickets!

== New Support System ==

Greetings everyone!

As part of our commitment to improve every aspect of ArcheAge Classic with the upcoming major updates, you'll be able to find an upgraded Support system on the website!

To submit a ticket, users are now encouraged to go on their website Profile, under the SUPPORT tab.

The existing Discord tickets will not be disabled yet but we are strongly encouraging users to migrate over there for any new tickets!
